name: Bytebeat
author: Tim Churches
description: Four integer expressions read as audio, pitch-tracked and with an openable mask width. From Tim Churches' Bees-in-the-Trees firmware for Braids.

controls.label: Term A
controls.description: Sets the first coefficient inside the expression, which mostly governs harmonic density.

controls.label: Term B
controls.description: Sets the second coefficient, which mostly governs how the pattern evolves over time.

controls.label: Expression
controls.description: Selects one of four expressions, from the softest and most tonal to the harshest.

controls.label: Mask width
controls.description: Opens the mask from two bits of the expression to twelve, past the stock eight.

outputs.aux: The same expression at half the tick rate, a locked sub-octave.
